title: あめふり (Amefuri — Rain Is Falling)
description: A beloved 1925 rainy-day children's song (童謡) with lyrics by 北原白秋 and music by 中山晋平, first published in コドモノクニ (November 1925). A child walks home in the rain, delighted that their mother has come to meet them with a snake-eye umbrella (じゃのめ). Spotting a soaked child crying by a willow, they offer their own umbrella and shelter under their mother's big parasol instead. The cheerful onomatopoeia refrain 'ピッチピッチ チャップチャップ ランランラン' has made this one of Japan's most beloved rainy-season songs.
